sections.heading: Raima Sen — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Raima Sen was born on 7 November 1979 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality. She was given the name Raima Dev Verma at birth and is publicly known as Raima Sen.
Public records name her father, Bharat Dev Varma and her mother, Moon Moon Sen. She is a sibling of Riya Sen.
She received her education at University of Calcutta, Loreto House and Rani Birla Girls' College.
She is recorded as speaking Bangla, Hindi and Malayalam.
